name: Falha de tarefa
description: Uma batida curta e abafada de madeira bruta, com a textura seca de um golpe feito à mão.
prompt: Real close-miked Foley of one short, restrained knock: a hand strikes a rough hollow log once with a small piece of raw hardwood. A low, dry woody thud with a slightly gritty contact and an immediate natural decay. Primitive, handmade and tactile. Isolated single impact. No melody, pitched chimes, synth, electronic tones, metallic ringing, reverberation, voices, or ambience.
